description: Small reviewed impact map for ordinary development: which focused tests, native routes, neighbors and safety checks a change to a source family actually depends on. Matched against the working-tree diff by path pattern. This is not project-wide dependency inference; add a family only for a demonstrated shared dependency.

families.title: Save, archive commit and serialization barriers
nativeRoutes: persistence-p05-save/quick: real GetNextQuickslot route, first-ever then oldest-slot overwrite (rotation)
persistence-p05-load/quick: separate-process cold load of the produced Quick save
persistence-p05-save/auto: real GetNextAutoslot route with rotation
persistence-p07-save/area-cross-entry-auto: the actual area-transition AfterEntry autosave event
persistence-p07-save/locked-replace: replacement failure keeps the previous archive
neighbors: cold load and presentation restore (MountedPersistenceService.World.cs, MountedLoadAdmission.cs)
native action debt capture/restore (NativeCombatActorPersistence.cs, NativeCombatTurnPersistence.cs; multi-rt-debt-manual, multi-tb-debt-manual)
area transition restore before autosave (MountedAreaPersistence.cs; multi-area-autosave)
safetyChecks: isolated save authority and write leases (PersistenceSaveAuthorizationTests, Test-PersistenceContracts.ps1)
protected human saves and exact restoration (scoped preflight; runtime transaction state)
no diagnostic-only authorization is required for ordinary play (NativePersistenceIsolation prefixes pass through when unbound)

families.title: Load admission, world replacement and restoration
nativeRoutes: persistence-p07-save/area-cross-entry|area-cross-exit: area transitions with restoration before autosave
persistence-p06-load/*: refusal of malformed, future and foreign archives
neighbors: schema migration and legacy archives (owned-schema1-*, legacy-schema1-resave-manual)
safetyChecks: load refusal never strips a human save; read-only isolated loads (Test-PersistenceContracts.ps1)
failed native load is never accounted as a completed world

families.title: Tier selector, budget and native launcher
nativeRoutes: none: offline orchestration only; a native launch is selected by its own request
neighbors: scripts/Test.ps1 (FULL umbrella) and every child wrapper that inherits KMC_WORKFLOW_BUDGET_ENTRY
safetyChecks: a refusal happens before any lock, staging or launch and never interrupts a running transaction
plan-only invocations build nothing, lock nothing and start no game
